Bobbie describes her experience at the parade, the shooting, and their escape.
Alison asks Bobbie about her grandson's reaction.
Alison asks Bobbie about her plans to talk to the children in her childcare center about the shooting.
Alison asks Bobbie if she will ever take her grandson to a parade again.
Bobbie expresses her frustration and urges people to take action to stop gun violence.
Alison expresses her agreement and thanks Bobbie for the interview.
